title: ajugoides humilis
intro: Ajugoides humilis, commonly known as Ajuga, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Ajuga include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents of Ajuga include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
